description: Read text content of a gameserver file (UTF-8 text up to 2 MB). Images, archives, compiled or encrypted scripts and other binary files cannot be read and return an error: do not retry them, use `list_gameserver_files` to see names and sizes instead. Credential values (passwords, tokens, connection strings) come back as [configured]; write the placeholder back unchanged to keep the stored value. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

scope.description: Without scope paths start at the server root (as `list_gameserver_files` without scope shows them); `config`/`active` resolve paths from the game data root; `savegame` additionally restricts to savegame paths. Read and write a file with the same scope.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: read_gameserver_file
title: Read Game Server File
